1: // Simple endless runner based on IDEA.md
2: // Canvas with id="game" must exist in the HTML.
3: (() => {
4:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
5:   if (!canvas) return console.error('Canvas with id "game" not found');
6:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
7:   const width = canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 800;
8:   const height = canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 400;
9: 
10:   // Player definition
11:   const player = {
12:     w: 40,
13:     h: 40,
14:     x: width / 2 - 20,
15:     y: height - 60,
16:     speed: 5,
17:     color: '#0ff'
18:   };
19: 
20:   const obstacles = [];
21:   const orbs = [];
22:   let score = 0;
23:   let gameOver = false;
24: 
25:   // Input handling
26:   const keys = {};
27:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => { keys[e.key] = true; });
28:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => { keys[e.key] = false; });
29: 
30:   function spawnObstacle() {
31:     const size = 30 + Math.random() * 30;
32:     obstacles.push({
33:       w: size,
34:       h: size,
35:       x: Math.random() * (width - size),
36:       y: -size,
37:       speed: 2 + Math.random() * 3,
38:       color: '#f44'
39:     });
40:   }
41: 
42:   function spawnOrb() {
43:     const r = 8 + Math.random() * 8;
44:     orbs.push({
45:       r,
46:       x: Math.random() * (width - 2 * r) + r,
47:       y: -r,
48:       speed: 2 + Math.random() * 2,
49:       color: '#ff0'
50:     });
51:   }
52: 
53:   function rectCollision(a, b) {
54:     return a.x < b.x + b.w && a.x + a.w > b.x && a.y < b.y + b.h && a.y + a.h > b.y;
55:   }
56: 
57:   function circleRectCollision(circle, rect) {
58:     const distX = Math.abs(circle.x - rect.x - rect.w / 2);
59:     const distY = Math.abs(circle.y - rect.y - rect.h / 2);
60:     if (distX > (rect.w / 2 + circle.r)) return false;
61:     if (distY > (rect.h / 2 + circle.r)) return false;
62:     if (distX <= (rect.w / 2)) return true;
63:     if (distY <= (rect.h / 2)) return true;
64:     const dx = distX - rect.w / 2;
65:     const dy = distY - rect.h / 2;
66:     return (dx * dx + dy * dy <= (circle.r * circle.r));
67:   }
68: 
69:   let obstacleTimer = 0;
70:   let orbTimer = 0;
71: 
72:   function update(delta) {
73:     if (gameOver) return;
74:     // Player movement
75:     if (keys['ArrowLeft'] || keys['a']) player.x -= player.speed;
76:     if (keys['ArrowRight'] || keys['d']) player.x += player.speed;
77:     player.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(width - player.w, player.x));
78: 
79:     // Spawn obstacles/orbs
80:     obstacleTimer += delta;
81:     orbTimer += delta;
82:     if (obstacleTimer > 1500) { spawnObstacle(); obstacleTimer = 0; }
83:     if (orbTimer > 1000) { spawnOrb(); orbTimer = 0; }
84: 
85:     // Update obstacles
86:     for (let i = obstacles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
87:       const o = obstacles[i];
88:       o.y += o.speed;
89:       if (rectCollision(player, o)) { gameOver = true; }
90:       if (o.y > height) obstacles.splice(i, 1);
91:     }
92: 
93:     // Update orbs
94:     for (let i = orbs.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
95:       const orb = orbs[i];
96:       orb.y += orb.speed;
97:       if (circleRectCollision(orb, player)) {
98:         score += 10;
99:         orbs.splice(i, 1);
100:       } else if (orb.y - orb.r > height) {
101:         orbs.splice(i, 1);
102:       }
103:     }
104:   }
105: 
106:   function draw() {
107:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);
108:     // Player
109:     ctx.fillStyle = player.color;
110:     ctx.fillRect(player.x, player.y, player.w, player.h);
111:     // Obstacles
112:     obstacles.forEach(o => {
113:       ctx.fillStyle = o.color;
114:       ctx.fillRect(o.x, o.y, o.w, o.h);
115:     });
116:     // Orbs
117:     orbs.forEach(orb => {
118:       ctx.fillStyle = orb.color;
119:       ctx.beginPath();
120:       ctx.arc(orb.x, orb.y, orb.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
121:       ctx.fill();
122:     });
123:     // Score
124:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
125:     ctx.font = '20px Arial';
126:     ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, 10, 30);
127:     if (gameOver) {
128:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
129:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
130:       ctx.fillStyle = '#f00';
131:       ctx.font = '40px Arial';
132:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
133:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', width / 2, height / 2);
134:     }
135:   }
136: 
137:   let last = performance.now();
138:   function loop(now) {
139:     const delta = now - last;
140:     last = now;
141:     update(delta);
142:     draw();
143:     if (!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
144:   }
145:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
146: })();
